 Versus

Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Sumit Joshi, Advocate holding brief 
of Mr. Ankush Kumar, learned counsel for the 
petitioners. 
2. Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand. 
3. Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Mr. Vinay Bhatt, learned counsel 
for the respondent-Sugar Mill.
4. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for 
Sugar Mill submits that predecessors in 
interest of the petitioners were engaged as 
daily wager, therefore, petitioners are not 
entitled for compassionate appointment. He 
further submits that petitioners have been 
engaged through contractor, thus, there is 
no relationship of employer and employee 
between sugar mill and petitioners. 
5. Learned counsel for the petitioners, 
however, sought time for filing rejoinder 
affidavit. 
6. On his request, list this case on 
24.03.2026.  7. It is made clear that no further time 
shall be given to counsel for the petitioners 
for filing rejoinder affidavit.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 16.03.2026
Aswal
